subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should the native encrypted snapshot backup flow continue toward core merge after hardening, or should the off-machine/cloud backup direction stay outside core for now?
rationale: The PR adds a large security-sensitive backup/restore surface with new config and destructive filesystem behavior, so maintainers need to confirm the core product boundary after the concrete blockers are fixed.

options.title: Harden Native Flow
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the target-path and verification fixes plus real CLI proof, then run a security-focused maintainer review.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer Core Scope
options.body: Pause or close the broad native snapshot scope and leave off-machine/cloud backup workflows to plugin or ClawHub tooling until a smaller core API is agreed.

recommendation.title: Harden Native Flow
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the target-path and verification fixes plus real CLI proof, then run a security-focused maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior backup safety and verification history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the core backup safety decision.
